prompt: Create an ultra-realistic cinematic 8K full-body portrait of a brooding young man standing in side profile on a vast cracked wet asphalt plain under a dark stormy sky. The subject has messy black hair and a short dark beard, a serious downward gaze, and a slim athletic build. Dress him entirely in distressed black clothing: one oversized worn black T-shirt, one long tattered sleeveless black outer layer or open vest trailing in the wind, one pair of black cargo pants, and one pair of heavy black lace-up combat boots. Behind him place one enormous circular eclipse-like portal: a nearly black disk outlined by a blazing molten golden ring, with sparks, embers, and fiery cracks along the circumference. Make the left half of the man’s body disintegrate into ash, smoke, dust, and glowing orange particles, as if being pulled into or burned away by the portal; the right half remains solid and sharply detailed. Use high-contrast dramatic lighting, warm golden rim light from the portal, cool gray ambient storm light, volumetric smoke, flying embers, realistic fabric texture, wet reflective ground, and a desaturated charcoal-and-gold color palette. Composition should be vertical, full body centered slightly right, portal filling most of the background, low horizon, cinematic depth, no text, no watermark, no extra people.

promptZh: 创作一幅超写实电影级 8K 全身肖像，描绘 一位留着凌乱黑发和短胡茬、神情忧郁的年轻人 侧身站在暴风雨灰暗天空下龟裂潮湿的柏油平原上。他身穿 一件超大号做旧黑色 T 恤、黑色工装裤和黑色战术靴，目光低垂，双臂自然下垂。在他身后是一个巨大的发光圆形日食光环，几乎填满整个画面，由炽热的金色等离子体、火花、熔岩裂纹和明亮的轮廓光组成。角色的左侧和下半身部分正在分解为烟雾状的灰烬、尘埃、黑色颗粒和金色余烬，仿佛正在消散融入光环的能量中；这种效果应从左肩和躯干开始，向下延伸至左腿，并向外扩散到空气中。采用高对比度的戏剧性光影，光环产生温暖的橙色背光，阴影部分冷色调且去饱和，呈现逼真的皮肤和织物纹理、体积烟雾、飞舞的碎片、湿地的反射，以及精致的超写实数字绘画美学。构图：竖向肖像，全身可见，角色略微偏右，发光光环位于其身后中心，低地平线，具有电影级的景深和大气朦胧感。氛围：黑暗、末日感、忧郁、超自然。避免出现文字、标志、多余人物、卡通风格、色彩过饱和或人体结构模糊的情况。
